du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De09_P1_Travel.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới (đề tiếng Anh như thi thật). File phụ (ảnh, dữ liệu, 3D Models) nằm cùng thư mục bài làm.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the empty space at the bottom of the last page, insert a Cloud shape that contains the text “Contact us today!”. Position the shape at the bottom left of the page with tight text wrapping.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Insert > Shapes > Cloud; kéo vẽ hình ở cuối trang cuối.  2) Nhấp phải hình > Add Text > gõ "Contact us today!".  3) Shape Format > Position > Position in Bottom Left with Square Text Wrapping.  4) Shape Format > Wrap Text > Tight.

cham.de_bai: In the empty space at the bottom of the last page, insert a Cloud shape that contains the text “Contact us today!”. Position the shape at the bottom left of the page with tight text wrapping.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the blank paragraph directly below the title banner, insert a table of contents. Use the Automatic Table 1 style.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ vào đoạn trống ngay dưới khung tiêu đề (banner).  2) References > Table of Contents > Automatic Table 1.

cham.de_bai: In the blank paragraph directly below the title banner, insert a table of contents. Use the Automatic Table 1 style.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Use a Word feature to replace all instances of “Mekong Travel” with “Mekong Co.”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Home > Replace (Ctrl+H).  2) Find what: Mekong Travel; Replace with: Mekong Co..  3) Replace All > OK.

cham.de_bai: Use a Word feature to replace all instances of “Mekong Travel” with “Mekong Co.”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Accept all tracked insertions and deletions. Reject all formatting changes.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Review > Show Markup > bỏ tích Formatting (chỉ còn hiện Insertions and Deletions).  2) Review > Accept > Accept All Changes Shown.  3) Review > Show Markup > tích lại Formatting.  4) Review > Reject > Reject All Changes (lúc này chỉ còn các thay đổi định dạng).

cham.de_bai: Accept all tracked insertions and deletions. Reject all formatting changes.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Venue” section, add a shape after “Assessing Learning Through Portfolios” in the SmartArt graphic. Enter the text “Supporting Students with Diverse Needs” in the new shape.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Bấm chọn hình "Assessing Learning Through Portfolios" trong SmartArt.  2) SmartArt Design > Add Shape > Add Shape After.  3) Gõ: Supporting Students with Diverse Needs (hoặc nhập trong Text Pane).

cham.de_bai: In the “Venue” section, add a shape after “Assessing Learning Through Portfolios” in the SmartArt graphic. Enter the text “Supporting Students with Diverse Needs” in the new shape.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Contact Us” section, resize the table so that each column is 2" (5.08 cm) wide.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn toàn bộ bảng.  2) Table Layout > Width (Cell Size): 2" (hoặc Table Properties > Column > Preferred width).

cham.de_bai: In the “Contact Us” section, resize the table so that each column is 2" (5.08 cm) wide.
